bibl.title: The dating of SB XVI 12524, SB XIV 11264, and the archiphylakites.
bibl.seg: 145.4 P. E.E.S. Inv. 14 K, No. 1 P. Med. XIV Congr. 1
Roberto Mascellari, The dating of SB XVI 12524, SB XIV 11264, and the archiphylakites.
bibl.note: S.B. XVI, 12524 [= P. E.E.S. Inv. 14 K, No. 1] and S.B. XIV, 11264 [= P. Med. XIV Congr. 1], which mention archiphylakitai and have been dated to the Augustan age by their editors, are compatible with Ptolemaic dates. The archiphylakites is not otherwise attested in the Roman period.
